summary: Learn bank income reconciliation, leakage detection, and control reporting through practical exercises. Explore the five-day course and outline.
lede: Revenue assurance in banking checks that interest, fees, commissions and payment income are accurately calculated, captured, reconciled and reported. For revenue assurance analysts, finance controllers and banking operations managers, it provides a practical approach to tracing income from product rules and transactions through ledger reporting. Exercises cover mapping revenue flows, testing fee and interest calculations, designing reconciliations and prioritizing exceptions for remediation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for banking professionals who investigate income accuracy, reconcile transaction records, oversee revenue controls, or report financial control issues. It suits people with operational or analytical experience who need a consistent approach to tracing bank income from product rules through ledger reporting.
modules: Bank Revenue Lifecycle and COSO Controls
Exception Analytics and Power BI Reporting
Revenue Assurance Governance and Action Planning
prerequisites: Prior experience in banking operations, finance control, reconciliations, internal audit, or product control is recommended. You should be comfortable reviewing transaction and ledger data in a spreadsheet. No programming is required. Exercises use supplied datasets and prepared Power BI materials; advanced analytics and AI anomaly detection are introduced conceptually.
